## Role of `brpc.policy.AddServersInBatch.replicas`

The graph models the anchor as a Function node scoped inside `ConsistentHashingLoadBalancer::AddServersInBatch` in `src/brpc/policy/consistent_hashing_load_balancer.cpp` (range 265–265, signature `()`), defined by evidence **E-CODE-9cec5b84fb52b556c0c332c9**, and a member of the `src/brpc` shard (**E-SHARD-6487ab8c99b36b477f261e90**, relation `MEMBER_OF`).

In source, line 265 is `std::vector<Node> replicas;` — the per-server scratch buffer of virtual ring nodes. Inside `AddServersInBatch` (src/brpc/policy/consistent_hashing_load_balancer.cpp:261-282) it is cleared and refilled for each `ServerId` via `GetReplicaPolicy(_type)->Build(servers[i], _num_replicas, &replicas)`, and the produced nodes are appended into `add_nodes` for one bulk `AddBatch` insertion into the hash ring. Its size is `_num_replicas` (constructor default `FLAGS_chash_num_replicas = 100`, line 174), which is exactly the channel parameter parsed at line 420 (`if (key == "replicas") return butil::StringToSizeT(value, &_num_replicas);`) — i.e. the number of virtual nodes ("replicas") per server on the consistent-hashing ring.

## Documentation describing it

The explain-symbol bundle resolved the anchor to the **c_murmurhash_bl** section of the load-balancer documentation, via two cross-layer `DOCUMENTS` edges (provenance `explicit_symbol_reference`, status `resolved`, confidence 0.7):

- **docs/en/client.md** (section `docs/en/client.md#10b2646294acf078`, lines 287–290, heading path "This line is ignored / Load Balancer / c_murmurhash_bl") — evidence **E-XLINK-e0e9be2cf50f895bf973243a**. The section text: *"c_murmurhash_bl … is consistent hashing with bounded loads … The `replicas` parameter is supported as in `c_murmurhash`."*
- **docs/cn/client.md** (section `docs/cn/client.md#79c3f03a99dbabb5`, lines 286–289, heading "… / 负载均衡 / c_murmurhash_bl") — evidence **E-XLINK-3284c4dde04ede3b45992a17**. The Chinese equivalent: *"`replicas` 参数的支持与 `c_murmurhash` 相同。"*

## Code/document evidence explained

- **Code evidence**: E-CODE-9cec5b84fb52b556c0c332c9 (`DEFINES`, line 265) plus E-SHARD-6487ab8c99b36b477f261e90 (`MEMBER_OF` shard `src/brpc`) establish the symbol's location and role: the vector of replica nodes materialized per server when servers are batch-added to the ring, sized by the `replicas` count (`_num_replicas`).
- **Document evidence**: the two `DOCUMENTS` cross-layer edges connect document sections to the code symbol because the section text names `replicas` as the supported per-channel parameter of the consistent-hashing load balancers; the c_murmurhash section of the same document defines the parameter (virtual nodes per server, default `-chash_num_replicas=100`, overridable as `c_murmurhash:replicas=300`), and c_murmurhash_bl states it is supported identically. This matches the code path `ParseParameters` → `"replicas"` → `_num_replicas`, which is the very count driving the `replicas` buffer in `AddServersInBatch`.
- Caveats: the bundle suppressed two additional document-side evidence entries under its budget (not cited here, per the returned-ID constraint), and the graph's node kind "Function" is its modeling of this one-line local declaration.
